title: Engineering the non-Hermitian Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model with skin effects in Rydberg atom arrays
summary: We propose and systematically analyze a practical scheme for implementing a one-dimensional non-Hermitian (NH) Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model using individually addressable Rydberg atom arrays. Our setup consists of an atomic chain with three-atom unit cells, in which a synthetic gauge field is generated by applying multicolor laser fields. By engineering fast dissipative channels for one auxiliary atom in each unit cell, adiabatic elimination effectively gives rise to a NH skin effect.
